thread:
Alex M: Heads up — aurora-13b landed in the catalog but the weights were moved to a new path. Need someone to confirm weights_path + sha256 before we mark it ready. Also saw a tokenizer/BOS quirk on the first smoke run.
Maya R: Where's the checksum file? I can update the catalog entry once we confirm.
Alex M: Found a sha256 at s3://redwood-models/aurora/13b/v2/sha256.txt. Quick check: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/aurora/13b/v2/sha256.txt -` should print it.
Samir K: I'll pull the weights and validate locally. Also the tokenizer header looked odd — cls_token is null while bos_token is set. That can cause off-by-one in prompts.
Tomo: Can you paste the tokenizer header?
Alex M: Sure — small snippet from tokenizer.json: ```
"bos_token": "<s>",
"eos_token": "</s>",
"cls_token": null
```
Samir K: Ok — two choices: set `cls_token` to "<s>" or update the catalog config to treat bos_token as cls. For serving we prefer explicit `cls_token`. If we leave null, some clients prepend an extra token which inflates seq length.
Maya R: I'll add a `tokenizer_settings.use_bos_as_cls=false` flag and set `cls_token` in the catalog metadata. Also we should confirm `max_input_length` — the catalog currently says 4096 which caused OOMs on 80GB A100 with batch 8 in the smoke run. Should be 2048.
Alex M: Confirmed — 4096 was legacy. Changing to 2048 fixes immediate OOMs in our tests.
Samir K: Ran a quick perf smoke locally. Command I used: ```
./run_perf.sh --model aurora13b --weights s3://redwood-models/aurora/13b/v2 --batch_size 4 --seq 2048 --requests 200
```
Results: p50 ~32ms, p95 ~210ms, throughput ~48 tok/s per GPU (single GPU run). p95 is higher than we'd like.
Maya R: p95 210ms seems off. Try batch_size 2 and disable prompt packing for comparison. Also confirm whether this is the FP16 or q4 version — compilation flags matter here.
Tomo: There is a quantized variant v2-q4 at s3://redwood-models/aurora/13b/v2-q4. We should add a `variant` entry in the catalog and a fallback policy so Dedicated can auto-fallback to q4 under heavy load.
infra-bot: Perf job scheduled: job/aurora13b-smoke-2118765432 -> status: queued.
Samir K: Re-ran with bs=2 and prompt packing enabled. Command: ```
./run_perf.sh --model aurora13b --weights s3://redwood-models/aurora/13b/v2 --batch_size 2 --seq 2048 --pack_prompt true --requests 300
```
New results: p50 ~28ms, p95 ~120ms, throughput ~60 tok/s per GPU. So packing + smaller batch improved p95 and throughput.
Maya R: Good. Please add those numbers to the catalog README and include recommended defaults: `default_batch=2`, `max_input_length=2048`, `tokenizer_settings.cls_token=\"<s>\"`, and `preferred_variant: v2-q4` (for cost-aware routing).
Alex M: I opened PR #4923 with diffs: weights_path -> s3://redwood-models/aurora/13b/v2, sha256 added, tokenizer_settings updated, max_seq_len -> 2048, default_batch -> 2. Tagging @Maya R and @Samir K for review.
qa-bot: CI: catalog_diff check passed. Lint warnings: tokenizer flag missing in older entries -> emitted a warning (non-blocking).
Samir K: I'll add a small `perf-results.md` in the PR with command lines and raw timing JSON. Also adding a short note about KV-cache warmup affecting first-request latency.
Maya R: After infra perf job finishes and infra/eng-runtime sign off, we can merge. Please also include an entry in CHANGELOG/catalog-updates.md with the fallback policy note.
Alex M: Sounds good. I'll wait for the infra job and then merge once green. Thanks everyone :rocket:
